notes: Saudia Dairy and Foodstuff Company (SADAFCO) — Tadawul-listed Saudi food group focused on UHT (long-life) milk under the Saudia brand, plus tomato paste, ice cream, snacks and cheese. Operates in Saudi Arabia + GCC + Levant + sub-Saharan Africa export markets. Fiscal year ends 31 March (FY2024 = year to Mar-2024; FY2025 = year to Mar-2025). SAR reporting; figures in SAR millions. Net cash balance sheet (essentially no debt; large cash + short-term investments). Capital-light vs Almarai (no upstream dairy farms — sources milk powder + raw milk). Strong dividend track record. SADAFCO has no direct farmland ownership; classified as Dairy / Egg Producer in the comps universe (acresK omitted). Multi-year history below shows compounding revenue and earnings growth driven by category expansion and price discipline.

periods.notes: FY21: COVID demand for shelf-stable milk; price discipline maintained
FY22: input cost inflation (milk powder, packaging); pricing actions late in year
FY23: full impact of pricing flowed through; commodity easing
FY24: record revenue and net income; export expansion across MENA
FY25: continued category growth; strong cash generation; bonus issue effect on shares unchanged
